# Tom Carlson — UGC Creator

> Tom Carlson is a Los Angeles-based UGC (user-generated content) creator and former engineer who produces video and photo content for health, wellness, fitness, sports and tech brands. He has created content for 100+ brands, including C4 Energy, True Classic, Harry's, Joymode, HackMotion and Brickell Men's Skincare.

Tom specializes in scroll-stopping hooks and conversion-focused CTAs for organic social posting and paid ad campaigns. Services include organic ads, paid targeted campaign content, script reading and voiceover, UGC photography, monthly retainers, and custom packages. Rates are provided upon request.

## Formats

Unboxings, reviews, product demos, testimonial-style videos, storytime ads, voiceover videos, app/software walkthroughs, and UGC product photography. Delivered for organic posting or paid social (usage rights and whitelisting available).

## Process

1. Brand sends the product and goal.
2. Tom returns hook and script concepts.
3. Align on direction.
4. Shoot, edit and deliver — with a CTA built to convert.

## FAQ

- Pricing: quoted per project, based on number of deliverables, usage rights (organic vs paid/whitelisted), turnaround, creative direction, and one-off vs retainer. Batches and retainers cost less per video. Details: https://tomcugc.com/pricing.html
- Usage rights / whitelisting: available on any package for paid social (including Spark Ads and Partnership Ads).
- Location: Los Angeles, CA; serves brands across the US.
